meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在已有的 AKS 集群上按六步带你走:验证集群、安装 controller、评估 GPU、安装推理提供方、部署第一个模型、最后总结。它会报告每步状态(正常/缺失),并在安装或部署前先征求你确认。
howto.when: 当你想在已有的 AKS 集群上安装 AI Runway、把模型部署到 AKS,或提到 “airunway setup”、“GPU inference on AKS” 等关键词时触发;没有集群时它会先转给 azure-kubernetes。

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through six steps on an existing AKS cluster: verify the cluster, install the controller, assess GPUs, set up an inference provider, deploy a first model, then summarize. It reports cluster state and asks for confirmation before installs or deployments.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to set up AI Runway on an existing AKS cluster, deploy a model to AKS, or say things like “airunway setup” or “GPU inference on AKS”.
